acceptance_limits: Agent Control application/runtime completion is tracked separately. HCDR v3 is the active default local transport to HOCUONG through the GitHub relay. No dedicated HCDR action is required in chat; the GitHub connector is the control-plane path.

transport.route: ChatGPT GitHub connector -> HCDecorAD/HCDecor-HCDR-Relay issue(hcdr-job) -> HOCUONG HCDR v3 -> hcdr-result/v2 comment
transport.unavailable_rule: Only declare HCDR unavailable if the GitHub relay path itself is inaccessible or a fresh health job fails. Absence of a dedicated tool/action named HCDR is not evidence of HCDR unavailability.
